interpretation_verdict: The Libyan COD ad market does NOT support the literal ultrasonic-CLEANER (jewelry/eyeglass) reading of this product: every Arabic ultrasonic-cleaner query — منظف بالموجات, غسالة الموجات, جهاز تنظيف بالموجات فوق الصوتية, منظف النظارات — returned zero Libyan advertisers, and the English 'ultrasonic cleaner' surfaced only foreign B2B pages (Alibaba/CODYSON, Akua, Evo Dyne, ETMM, Loudly Optical) whose ads merely reach Libya. The interpretation the local market actually supports is the ultrasonic HUMIDIFIER / aroma-DIFFUSER / atomizer ('فواحة / مرطب الهواء / مبخرة كهربائية / جهاز ترطيب وتعطير') — this is the one clearly sold COD by Libyan pages (Wahalibya, La Bellezza Store, and a portable mist/atomizer cooler by 4F Badia). A strong SECONDARY home-appliance reading is the ultrasonic/electronic PEST-REPELLER (Top montajat, priced in Libyan dinar). The skin-scrubber (beauty) reading is essentially absent as a standalone COD product (سكرابر البشرة = 1 ad; 'جهاز تنظيف البشرة' hits appear only via aesthetic clinics, not device sellers), and the 'جهاز الموجات فوق الصوتية' phrase in Libya maps mostly to medical/clinic ultrasound plus the one pest-repeller. Since the source SKU is tagged 'Home Appliances', the best-supported interpretation for the Libyan market is the ultrasonic humidifier/aroma-diffuser/atomizer, with ultrasonic pest-repeller as the secondary candidate.
